note: Tables MYE5 (population density: land area in square kilometres and people per square kilometre) and MYE6 (median age) of the mid-2025 workbook, read by scripts/build/build-mye5-density.mjs into src/data/live/ons-mye5-density.json. The workbook is the same file as data/raw/manifests/ons_mye.json, byte for byte (same SHA-256). The 4 November 2026 fetch by scripts/fetch/fetch-ons-mye.mjs is recorded here rather than appended to ons_mye.json, because the county publication gate (scripts/lib/county-audit.mjs) hashes that manifest whole and a new attempt line would need a separately reviewed refresh. The run made one request each for robots.txt (HTTP 404, recorded as absent), the dataset page (to resolve the current edition) and the workbook. A dry run of the same script a minute earlier made one request each for robots.txt and the dataset page, and none for the workbook. The Nomis dataset API was not used.
